An untrusted document that references an attacker-controlled image URL receives the caller's credentials. ### Details `docling/backend/utils/image_resource_loader.py` merges `options.headers` into each remote request without checking the destination against the source document's origin. `requests` strips only `Authorization` on a cross-host redirect, so custom headers such as `X-API-Key` or `Cookie` are also forwarded across redirects. ### Affected configurations - Affected: callers that set `headers` together with `enable_remote_fetch=True` and `fetch_images=True` (CLI: `--html-image-headers` with `--html-image-fetch remote` or `all`), and convert untrusted HTML. - Not affected: the default configuration. ### Impact Disclosure of the configured request headers, typically credentials, to a host chosen by the document author. ### Proof of concept ```html ``` Converting this file with `HTMLBackendOptions(enable_remote_fetch=True, fetch_images=True, headers={"X-API-Key": "..."})` sends the key to `attacker.example`. Other items from the original report (DNS validation and unvalidated browser requests) are tracked in GHSA-pc36-qwjq-x68c. ### Patches Fixed in docling 2.132.0 by [#4420](https://github.com/docling-project/docling/pull/4420). Configured headers are now sent only to the origin of the source document, checked on every redirect hop, and no longer to other hosts named by the document. ### Workarounds Upgrade to 2.132.0. For older versions: Do not set `headers` when converting untrusted documents, or use credentials that are valid only for the intended host and have no other value.", "epss": {"percentage": 0.00218, "percentile": 0.11199}, "ghsa_id": "GHSA-p3fw-7699-7926", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-10-07T20:42:24Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p3fw-7699-7926", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-p3fw-7699-7926"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-105742"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-10-05T22:16:56Z", "published_at": "2026-10-07T20:42:24Z", "references": ["https://github.com/docling-project/docling/security/advisories/GHSA-p3fw-7699-7926", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105742", "https://github.com/docling-project/docling/pull/4420", "https://github.com/docling-project/docling/commit/5e469137f275ffc443306a30d12a3a45bceb80fb", "https://github.com/docling-project/docling/releases/tag/v2.132.0", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p3fw-7699-7926"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/docling-project/docling/security-advisories/GHSA-p3fw-7699-7926", "severity": "low", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/docling-project/docling", "summary": "Docling: Configured HTTP headers sent to every remote image host named by a document", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-10-07T20:42:25Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-p3fw-7699-7926", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "2.132.0", "package": {"ecosystem": "pip", "name": "docling"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": ">= 2.95.0, < 2.132.0"}, {"first_patched_version": "2.132.0", "package": {"ecosystem": "pip", "name": "docling-slim"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": ">= 2.95.0, < 2.132.0"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
